Metadata.title: Hag & Ink — Barber & Tattoo in Gombe, Kinshasa
Metadata.description: Fades, locks, colour and tattoo at 2 Avenue Colonel Lukusa, Gombe (Forescom roundabout). Artists' hands, by appointment.

Home.heroText: Fades, locks, colour and tattoo: every cut is crafted as a one-off piece, in the heart of Gombe.
Home.chapter1Text: A salon designed like a studio: black lines, architectural light, every corner has its style.
Home.chapter2Text: Fades, locks, colour: our barbers treat every cut as a unique piece.
Home.chapter3Text: Barbers who master the detail, from the fade to the sculpted beard.
Home.servicesText: Fixed prices, pay at the shop. Booking confirmed instantly.
Home.teamText: Pick your barber, or we'll place you with the first one available.
Home.paymentNote: Pay at the shop (cash or Mobile Money).

Ambassadors.title: Create with Hag & Ink
Ambassadors.intro: Do you create content in Kinshasa (Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat)? Become an ambassador: your personal link, your promo code for your community, and free services based on your results.
Ambassadors.how2: The salon reviews your profile and replies.
Ambassadors.how3: You get your link and code, and you share.
